name: Native Select
summary: A native select is the browser's own select element, restyled with appearance: none and a CSS caret. Use it for one choice from a list of text options. It is the better default on a phone, where it opens the OS picker, and the trade is that the open list cannot be styled at all.
demoNote: No JavaScript on this page. Open one on a phone and you get the OS picker: full height, scrollable, with the platform's own screen reader behavior.

contract.useWhen: One choice from a list of text options, and the better default on a phone.
